strategies.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight text-white drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,229,255,0.5)]
strategies.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: The 'Control Room' Grid heavily modified for a central stage (Hero focus) and right sidebar (Money Tree). Asymmetrical focus on the center hexagon.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16. Use generous p-8 in the main question container to give breathing room.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Center-aligned for the main question and answers to mimic the TV broadcast. Left-aligned for the money tree sidebar.

surface_strategies.question_hexagon: Glassmorphism with a sharp 1px border. bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-white/20 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]
surface_strategies.answer_buttons: The 'Tracing Beam' inspired. Default: solid dark blue with glowing cyan border. Hover: border turns gold, slight scale up. Active/Selected: solid gold. Correct: pulsing green. Wrong: red.
surface_strategies.money_tree: Neumorphism mix. Dark glass panel with bright highlighted text for the current level. Past levels dimmed.

components_usage.buttons: Custom HTML/Tailwind for the hexagonal answer buttons to capture the TV show shape. No standard Shadcn button for answers. Use Shadcn for form inputs and admin question creation.
components_usage.inputs: Shadcn UI Input, heavily styled with dark mode colors and gold focus rings.
components_usage.jokers: Circular buttons with glassmorphism, floating top right. When used, cross them out with a red slash.

animations.entrance: Staggered fade-in and slide-up for answers. (delay: 0.2s each)
animations.selection: Pulsing gold background (is it your final answer?) for 2-3 seconds before revealing correct.
animations.correct: Flash rapid white/green, then solid glowing green.
animations.money_tree_progress: Smooth vertical slide of the active indicator.

media.sound_instructions: Implement royalty-free sounds for hover (click), selection (tension hum), correct (triumphant bell), wrong (dissonant strike), and background atmospheric loop.

testing.instructions: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install specific fonts via Google Fonts: Chivo and Outfit.
Build the TV show's 'Hexagon' answer buttons using CSS clip-path (polygon(5% 0, 95% 0, 100% 50%, 95% 100%, 5% 100%, 0% 50%)) to faithfully recreate the iconic look.
Add 'Jokers' (50:50, Phone a Friend, Ask the Audience) visually as round floating buttons. When used, apply a crossed-out visual state.
Ensure 'is final answer?' tension logic: When clicking an answer, wait 2-3 seconds before showing correct/wrong, pulsing the button gold during this wait to build tension like in the show.
